rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NATIONAL POLICY IN PREVENTING ADOLESCENT 
PREGNANCIES AND INSTITUTIONALIZING SOCIAL PROTECTION FOR 
ADOLESCENT PARENTS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish the Adolescent Pregnancy Prevention Inter-Agency Council which shall serve as the policy-making body responsible for the formulation and implementation of policies and program that shall provide family-oriented, adolescent-friendly sexual and reproductive health programs, centered on the prevention, counseling, and post-delivery care of adolescent pregnancy, through the development of coherent, rational, unified, effective and efficient structures, systems, and mechanisms for social protection program in the adolescents with health and development concerns primarily on sexual and reproductive health.
Develops an evidence-based National Medium-Term Plan for the Prevention of Adolescent Pregnancy which shall serve as the national framework for inter-agency and inter-sectoral collaboration and resource allocation at all levels, to address the various health, cultural, socio-economic, and institutional determinants of adolescent pregnancy.
Mandates all provinces and chartered cities to organize and operationalize an Information and Service Delivery Network (ISDN) for Adolescent Health Development (AHD) consisting of different government agencies and NGOs, institutions, and facilities disseminating information and services to adolescents within their locality.
Provides for the roles and responsibilities of different concerned agencies in accordance to their mandates and in relation to the implementation of this Act.
Designates February of every year as the month for raising public awareness on preventing adolescent pregnancy and conduct of nationwide communication campaign.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT ENHANCING THE FISCAL REGIME FOR THE MINING INDUSTRY, AMENDING
FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 34(B), AND CREATING NEW SECTIONS 151-A,
151-B, 151-C, AND 151-D, ALL UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, OTHERWISE
KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS
AMENDED
rows.title_short: Enhancing The Fiscal Regime For The Mining Industry, Amending For The Purpose Section 34( B), And Creating New Sections 151- A, 151- B, 151- C, And 151- D, All Under Republic Act No. 8424, Otherwise Known As The National Internal Revenue Code Of 1997, As Amended
rows.abstract:
Aims for the following objectives:  to enhance the equitable share of the government in the utilization of natural resources, to implement a rationalized fiscal regime for large-scale metallic mines, and to promote transparency and accountability in the management of resources derived from extractive industries.

Proposes key provisions regarding the following:

Royalty payments covering large-scale metallic mining operations within and outside mineral reservations and small-scale metallic mining operations; Margin-based windfall profits tax gained; Thin capitalization to avoid high interest expense deductions due to excessive debt financing, thereby reducing corporate tax liability; Ring-fencing to prevent consolidation of income and expenses of all projects by the same tax payer; Registration with the Mines and Geosciences Bureau and the Mining Board of concerned LGU to qualify for the awarding of a People´s Small-Scale Mining Contract; Reports on all sales and exportation of minerals, etc. to BIR, and essay reports from discharge ports to the DOF and the BIR; Fiscal transparency and accountability in the utilization of mineral resources, exempts related businesses, etc. from the application of confidentiality clauses of the NIRC, as amended.

rows.author: A069;H057;K036;E046;I033;K001;K055;F028;C102;K048;K018;K061;J093;I041;J127;J066;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THE MAGNA CARTA FOR TAXPAYERS
rows.title_short: Providing The Magna Carta For Taxpayers
rows.abstract:
Intends to enhance protection of taxpayer´s rights, boost their trust and confidence in government revenue authorities, and improve tax compliance by educating them about their duties and responsibilities.
	 	 
Proposes to codify taxpayer´s basic rights for better taxpayer education and prevention of abuses and violations committed against them.

Provides for taxpayers´ duties and responsibilities as follows:  to comply with tax laws; to truthfully and timely disclose information; to lodge and submit required complete documents on time; to keep and make records available for examination; to cooperate with revenue authorities during tax audits; and to timely pay taxes.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT CREATING A SUSTAINABLE FISCAL FRAMEWORK FOR THE
PENSION SYSTEM OF THE MILITARY AND UNIFORMED PERSONNEL,
PROVIDING MECHANISMS FOR THE DISPOSITION OF GOVERNMENT ASSETS
FOR THE PURPOSE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Military And Uniformed Personnel Pension System Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to secure and guarantee the sustainability of the pension system for the Military and Uniformed Personnel (MUP) by establishing a fiscal framework that supports their funding requirements.
Provides for the following, among others: 1. monthly retirement pay of fifty percent (50%) of the base pay and longevity pay of the grade next higher than the permanent grade last held by the personnel in case of twenty years in active service with an increase by two and one-half percent (2.5%) for every year of active service beyond twenty years to a maximum of ninety percent (90%) for thirty-six years of active service and over; 2. MUP who separate and resigns from the service before reaching twenty (20) years of satisfactory active service shall receive a  separation pay equivalent to one month base pay plus longevity pay of the permanent grade of  MUP holds at the time of separation for every year of active service; 3.  Subjects the pension of retired MUP and survivorship pension  of survivors to an automatic indexation of not exceeding fifty percent (50%) of the increase in the base pay of the MUP in active service holding the same rank during the same year.
Provides for two (2) MUP trust funds such as a.) Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Trust Fund; and b.) Uniformed Personnel Services (UPS) Trust Fund.
Grants assistance to indigent pensioners which shall be financed out of the AFP Trust Fund and the UPS Trust Fund.
Exempts MUP Trust Funds, its assets, revenues, including all accruals, and benefits paid from all taxes, assessments, fees, charges, or duties of all kinds.
